summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Room Gallery section on the Hotel Terme Leonardo redesign. All 8 acceptance criteria pass: section renders, is positioned between Rooms (#camere y=2427) and Dining (#ristorante y=4496) with gallery at y=3188; 5 slides render with correct data-testids (single/double/queen/junior/suite) and prices €100/€90/€90/€105/€115; all 5 images load from https://www.termeleonardo.com/img/ with naturalWidth=1980; Next/Prev buttons advance/rewind the embla carousel (selected dot indicator updates from 0->1->0); clicking room-dot-3 jumps directly to slide 4; Book links are anchors with target='_blank' pointing to https://www.termeleonardo.com/it; amenities panel renders with Wi-Fi/Minibar/Parking/Spa/Balcony/Bathrobe (IT localized: Accappatoio); language switch to EN updates title to 'Browse our rooms', book buttons to 'Book' and room names to Single/Double/Queen/Junior Suite/Suite in-session without reload.
critical_code_review_comments: RoomGallery.jsx is clean (~100 lines), uses data-testid consistently, embla carousel wired properly with select/reInit listeners, translations delegated via LanguageContext. No issues found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Room Gallery feature fully verified at 1920x900 viewport. Slides use ROOM_GALLERY keys (single/double/queen/junior/suite). All images externally hosted at termeleonardo.com and load successfully. Language switching is reactive via React context; do not reload page between switch and assertions.
